title: The Periodic Table as a Measured Object II: A Nuclear-Informed Cross-Scale Sequel on What Sharpens, Collapses, and Inverts Under a Stronger Atomic Closure
source_native_claims: Nuclear-informed sequel: replaces the 8-channel surface with a stronger 12-channel closure admitting neutron excess, binding energy per nucleon, magic-number proximity, valence-electron structure, and block order.

The paper does not replace chemistry and does not claim that the periodic table originates from the kernel; its burden is to determine which atomic distinctions sharpen, compress or collapse, and invert.
